$comment: Recorded inputs for the supervision estimate in honesty-notes.md.
This file exists so the number in that document is derived from something
written down rather than reasserted from memory each time. Nothing here is
measured: `exchanges` is a count of round trips (an instruction, a response,
a review), entered by hand at the end of a working session.
`minutesPerExchange` is the honest wide band — reading a long response,
verifying it in the running app, deciding, replying. `fixedMinutes` covers
one-off work that is not an exchange, like authoring the original spec.
The band is 4-8, not the 2-4 first guessed. 2-4 only covers reading; it
ignores the verifying, which is where the real minutes went — loading a
page to check an alignment fix, re-running the wizard, diffing a profile
against a backup. A one-word 'yes' pulls the average down, a screenshot
review pulls it up. Sanity check: the band has to roughly reproduce the
hand estimate it replaced, or one of the two is wrong.
scripts/update-supervision.mjs turns this into prose. Run by the pre-commit
hook in .githooks/, so the estimate cannot silently go stale.

sessions.note: Original specification and the first build: fourteen features, fixed stack, phased order, target macro numbers.
Licence, re-skin, multi-meal planning, generator tab, demo mode built and cut, audit, Storybook, atomic restructure.
